Walk. Compete. Keep them guessing.

Your steps

Bara reads your daily step count from Apple Health or Health Connect. That number is your position on the course.

The race

Start a race with friends over a day, a week, or a fortnight. Everyone's steps move them down the same trail, live.

The mischief

Mystery boxes drop as you walk. Inside: powerups to speed yourself up — or to slow your friends down and hear about it later.

What's in the boxes

Dozens of ways to shake up the race.

Mystery boxes drop as you walk. Some of what's inside gives you a boost. The rest is for having fun with your friends.

  • Trail Mine

    Buried on the course. Whoever hits it loses ground.

  • Leech

    Siphons a cut of a rival's steps to you.

  • Rainstorm

    Slows everyone caught in it for an hour.

  • Signal Jammer

    Hides the leaderboard from whoever's chasing you.

  • Shortcut

    Skip ahead while nobody's looking.

  • Lucky Horseshoe

    Better odds on whatever you open next.
